entries.title: EU AI Act Phase 2 Takes Effect August 2: Chatbot Disclosure, AI Office Enforcement Powers, and Full Penalty Regime Now Binding
entries.summary: The bulk of the EU AI Act becomes enforceable on August 2, 2026—including Article 50 transparency obligations (chatbot and deepfake labeling), AI Office enforcement powers over GPAI models, and fines up to €35M or 7% of global turnover—while the Annex III high-risk deadlines were separately deferred to December 2027 by the Omnibus already in force.

entries.title: Minnesota's First-in-Nation AI Nudification Platform Ban (HF 1606) Enters Force August 1 — xAI TRO Motion Still Pending
entries.summary: Minnesota's law banning platforms from offering AI nudification services—with $500,000-per-use civil penalties and no safe harbor—took effect today without a restraining order despite xAI's pending First Amendment challenge, making it the first enforced US law targeting AI content-generation platforms rather than individual users.

entries.title: arXiv 2607.27886: GradLock — Training-Time Supply-Chain Attack Achieves Pixel-Perfect (SSIM ≈ 1.0) Extraction of Private Training Data from Model Parameters
entries.summary: GradLock demonstrates that a compromised AI supply chain can stealthily inject private training data directly into model parameters with near-lossless recovery in under one second, resistant to quantization, pruning, and fine-tuning; 93.3% of study participants failed to detect the embedded malicious logic, exposing a critical blind spot in current AI supply-chain auditing.

entries.title: arXiv 2607.28196: Fidelity Is Not Safety — Gently-Compressed LLMs Pass Every Standard Quality Guard but Invent Procedure Steps in Agentic Execution
entries.summary: Coherent low-rank (SVD) compression passes perplexity, MMLU, and output-fidelity checks but causes LLMs to systematically hallucinate procedure steps during agentic SOP execution—a failure mode magnitude pruning at equivalent perplexity does not trigger—exposing a structural blind spot in current compression acceptance testing before agentic deployment.

entries.title: arXiv 2607.27267: FAVA — SMT-Verified Permission Graphs for LLM Agents Achieve 90.5% Decision Compliance Rate
entries.summary: FAVA translates natural-language agent tasks into formal permission graphs via an LLM-guided IR and applies SMT verification to block policy-violating actions before any execution, achieving a 90.5% Decision Compliance Rate across three agent safety benchmarks—the first framework to provide mathematical authorization guarantees for LLM agents at runtime.

entries.title: arXiv 2607.28147: Agent Harness Distillation — Proprietary Multi-Agent Inference-Time Harnesses Can Be Extracted via Black-Box Interactions
entries.summary: AHD demonstrates that the engineering IP embedded in autonomous multi-agent system harnesses can be extracted through black-box interactions alone, revealing substantial IP leakage risk across real-world AMAS deployments; the paper also proposes a deception-based defense that reduces extraction effectiveness while preserving legitimate agent utility.

entries.title: arXiv 2607.28146: ParliamentBench — Frontier LLMs Show Strong Deceptive Capability but Cannot Sustain Consistent Deceptive Personas Across Full Games
entries.summary: Using 1,600 simulated games of Secret Hitler, ParliamentBench finds that a strong frontier cluster (GPT-5.4, Kimi K2.5, Grok 4.1 Fast, DeepSeek 3.1) achieves high deceptive performance against human baselines, but deception retention drops below 50% across full game horizons for all tested models, while the weakest models fall below random baselines.

entries.title: EVOX Productions v. Midjourney (2:26-cv-08408): Automotive Photography Company Files Second AI Copyright Suit in C.D. Cal. This Month
entries.summary: EVOX Productions—the automotive photography company that also sued Stability AI on July 2—filed a new copyright case against Midjourney on July 30 in the Central District of California, continuing a targeted litigation campaign against AI image generators over copyrighted training data.

entries.title: Former Fed Chair Ben Bernanke Joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
entries.summary: Anthropic appointed Ben Bernanke to its Long-Term Benefit Trust—the internal oversight body charged with holding the company accountable to its public-benefit mission—adding institutional credibility to a governance mechanism that few other frontier AI developers have adopted and raising the bar for vendor oversight comparisons.

entries.title: Okta Agrees to Acquire Permiso Security for ~$200M — AI Agent Identity Governance Enters the Commercial Stack
entries.summary: Okta agreed to acquire Permiso Security for approximately $200 million in an almost all-cash deal to extend its identity governance platform to non-human and AI agent identities, the first major commercial acquisition specifically targeting the authorization and monitoring gap that autonomous AI agents create in enterprise infrastructure.
